gather_job_id.description: The gathering job; null for a class gathered from the plan's stores inside the gather state's transaction.

gather_state_id.description: The gather state of the remediation unit that recorded the failure.

kind.description: Closed per class: ci the failure_kind of the check (compile|test|lint|policy|unknown) or infra (a gather constituent that failed), a timed-out check being failure_class timed_out, never a kind; build compile|test|quality_gate|arch_gate|unparsed; review finding|evidence_missing; analysis gate_condition|issue|undecidable; merge_conflict conflict|remote_moved (the plan branch's remote moved under a rejected lease; source: the observed remote_sha); qgate finding.

source.description: check name, build job id, finding id, analysis provider, or conflicting path.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 over class, kind, file, and the normalized message; recognises a repeated failure (retry_not_applicable).

baseline.description: The failure is present with the same fingerprint on the base (Job Runtime, Baseline Separation).

gate.description: The waivable gate identifier the failure falls under; null when not waivable.
